q: The Cramér-Rao lower bound states that for any unbiased estimator θ̂ of θ:
opts: Var(θ̂) ≥ 1/I(θ) where I(θ) is the Fisher information
exp: Cramér-Rao: Var(θ̂) ≥ I(θ)⁻¹ where I(θ) is the Fisher information (scalar case). For n i.i.d. samples, Var(θ̂) ≥ 1/(n·I(θ)). The MLE achieves this bound asymptotically.
